The Story Behind Zibula Atudde

Zibula Atudde Family Business is a family-owned enterprise founded by KAVUMA JOHN. We bring different services together under one trusted name, making shopping, event preparation, construction supplies and financial transactions more convenient for every customer.

Family values guide everything we do: honest dealings, customer satisfaction, reliability, quality products and affordable services. As the business grows, we keep improving how we serve the community, so people can find what they need close to home.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I book tents or chairs?

Use the booking form above. Your request goes straight to our WhatsApp and we confirm availability and price.

Which events do you hire tents and chairs for?

We hire wedding tents, party tents, chairs, tables and other event equipment. Send us your event details and we will tell you what we can arrange.

Can I ask about hardware prices?

Yes. Message us on WhatsApp or call and we will give you current prices.

Which Mobile Money services do you offer?

We offer Airtel Money and MTN Mobile Money services, and we can help you through your transaction.
